briefdescription.para: Returns true if S is valid UTF-8, which is required for use as JSON.

detaileddescription.para: If it returns false, Offset is set to a byte offset near the first error.

briefdescription.para: Replaces invalid UTF-8 sequences in S with the replacement character (U+FFFD).

detaileddescription.para: The returned string is valid UTF-8. This is much slower than isUTF8, so test that first.

briefdescription.para: Parses the provided JSON source, or returns a ParseError.

detaileddescription.para: The returned Value is self-contained and owns its strings (they do not refer to the original source).
